label_bases.benchmark_derived: provisional ORCID agreement; not independent verification
label_bases.label_free: HAMMER outputs and provider status only

notes: Verified and benchmark-derived results are never combined into one figure.
Overall benchmark-derived retrieval keeps all N primary cases and is never adjusted by any audit or verified result.
Benchmark-group validity (group impurity) is reported separately from the definite-label audit error rate.
The audit error rate is not a correction factor and is not transferable to automatic assignments, other policies or overall retrieval.
scope.pool: captured R2 (name-only) candidate pool; R0 is descriptive only and is not an input to any C7 metric

scoring.note: Every automatic assignment of the primary pair must be verified (Decision A); `unverified` counts those that are not yet.

audit_sample.exclusions: only ground-truth unresolved cases (no unique intended person) and cases not yet verified or not definite; a HAMMER abstention is never an exclusion
audit_sample.judgment_categories_note: the conditional denominator is verified_same_in_pool; every other category is reported here and is outside it (verified_same_with_cannot_tell_candidates is a subset of verified_same_in_pool)
audit_sample.weighting: none: subset-specific, descriptive, never pooled with another subset or with benchmark-derived retrieval

automatic.exclusions: only ground-truth unresolved cases (no unique intended person) and cases not yet verified or not definite; a HAMMER abstention is never an exclusion
automatic.judgment_categories_note: the conditional denominator is verified_same_in_pool; every other category is reported here and is outside it (verified_same_with_cannot_tell_candidates is a subset of verified_same_in_pool)
automatic.weighting: none: subset-specific, descriptive, never pooled with another subset or with benchmark-derived retrieval
